content: Teasing this down into separate layers, Figure FIGREF41 shows the average (sorted) density of each head for each layer. We observe that $\alpha $-entmax is able to learn different sparsity patterns at each layer, leading to more variance in individual head behavior, to clearly-identified dense and sparse heads, and overall to different tendencies compared to the fixed case of $\alpha =1.5$.
